profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer ll at Crystal Dynamics
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the computer games industry. Strong engineering professional skilled in PSP, Multiplayer, Game Programming, HTML, and Visual Studio.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer ll
positions.description:
[Tomb Raider Catalyst]
- Lead Gameplay/Combat Programmer.  Lead team of engineers to develop immersive gameplay and combat experience.

[Marvel's Avengers]
-Lead Games as a Service Engineer. Oversaw team of engineers to maintain post-ship support of live title.

[Marvel's Avengers]
- Lead Gameplay Programmer.  Oversaw team responsible for player, ai and combat.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
[Battlefield: Hardline]
- Senior AI programmer responsible for navigation and locomotion.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
[Undisclosed Title]
- Lead AI programmer for multi-SKU project. Oversee AI team providing vision and direction. Responsible for combat and stealth, as well as NPC awareness and ambient behaviors.

[Tomb Raider]
- Gameplay programmer.  Responsible for multiple game features including, "aim-assist" cameras, coordinated melee combat and object health system.

[Undisclosed Title]
- Gameplay programmer for downloadable project.  Responsible for player combat, projectile and weapon systems, power-up and scoring system, as well as other programming necessary to support a small team.

[Undisclosed Title]
- Lead programmer responsible for a small team of engineers and artists.  Researched new platform for establishing future titles on hand-held device.

[Tomb Raider: Guardian of Light]
- Gameplay programmer.  Responsible for numerous player systems including, but not limited to, ground movement, combat, grapple and object interaction.  Responsible for network code needed to support game mechanics in multi-player.  Additional responsibilities included converting single player engine into multi-player engine.

[Tomb Raider: Underworld]
- Gameplay programmer.  Responsible for numerous game systems including object interaction, inventory, grapple, and wall rappel.  Additional systems included, portable objects, weapons and projectiles.

[Tomb Raider: Legend]
- Engine programmer.  Ported PS2 SKU to XBox 360 SKU.  Responsible for converting numerous library functions to new SKU including math, file system and save system.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
[Death Jr.]
- Gameplay and systems programmer.  Responsible for building PSP engine from scratch.  Systems included AI, file system, audio engine, UI, weapons and projectiles.

publications.title: Lara Croft and the Guardian of Light
